name: erp-remotenyx
description: Sistema ERP completo com PostgreSQL automático, controle financeiro, RH, estoque e dashboard

scripts.preinstall: npm config set fund false && npm config set audit false
scripts.install-all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('node_modules', {recursive: true, force: true}); require('fs').rmSync('server/node_modules', {recursive: true, force: true}); require('fs').rmSync('client/node_modules', {recursive: true, force: true})" && echo "Limpeza concluida"

author: Remotenyx
